name: ns_proofsearch_fractional_bridge
rubric_version_reason: Narrow theorem-search substrate for the route-5 anisotropic fractional pressure bridge after the metric-kernel substitution correction.
description: Bounded ZTARE audit for a Euclidean anisotropic Riesz projection bridge, counterexample, or reranking.

cage_meta.class_reason: Qualitative theorem-search substrate over a single NS fractional bridge eigenquestion.

disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rivals are adjudicated by theorem burden and counterexample quality, not formula gaps.
persona: You are a ruthless PDE theorem-search referee in Newton mode. The task is not to solve Navier-Stokes. The task is to decide whether route-5 metric degeneracy can be bridged to pressure-Hessian gain suppression through a Euclidean anisotropic Riesz projection estimate. The pressure operator remains Euclidean unless a coordinate-change/Jacobian theorem is supplied. Reward exact theorem-shaped bridge, admissible counterexample, or strict reranking. Penalize metric-kernel substitution, generic 2D-vortex prose, isotropic Sobolev fallback, hidden Calderon residuals, and regularity/blowup claims.

dimensions.name: Euclidean Pressure Discipline
dimensions.description: Does the submission keep the Navier-Stokes pressure Hessian as a Euclidean Riesz operator unless it proves a coordinate/Jacobian theorem?

dimensions.name: Projected Channel Specificity
dimensions.description: Does it target the projected pressure-stretch channel entering P(E), not pressure magnitude or visual pancake geometry?

dimensions.name: Bridge Or Obstruction Quality
dimensions.description: Does it provide a theorem-shaped Euclidean anisotropic bound, or an admissible thin-source counterexample?

dimensions.name: Admissibility And Scaling
dimensions.description: Does it state source thickness, support, amplitude, moments, parity/cancellation, and NS-critical scaling assumptions explicitly?

dimensions.name: Generative Yield
dimensions.description: Does it produce a concrete next theorem move for this exact fractional bridge: a usable Euclidean projection lemma, a named counterexample family to formalize, or a proof-cost reranking that changes the next NS build?

dimensions.name: Q Scalar Connection
dimensions.description: Does it explain how the result changes P(E) in Q(E)=L(E)v(E)/(P(E)w(E)) without back-solving from observed G and L?

dimensions.name: Claim Discipline
dimensions.description: Does it avoid claiming NS regularity/blowup and avoid hiding residual burdens?

criteria.Euclidean_Pressure_Discipline: Full credit requires treating H_p as R_i R_j(source) in Euclidean coordinates, or proving the exact coordinate/Jacobian theorem needed to transform it.
criteria.Projected_Channel_Specificity: Full credit requires a bound or counterexample for the projected pressure-stretch channel that contributes to P(E).
criteria.Bridge_Or_Obstruction_Quality: Full credit requires either a theorem-shaped Euclidean anisotropic Riesz projection estimate or an explicit admissible thin-source counterexample.
criteria.Admissibility_And_Scaling: Full credit requires explicit assumptions on thickness, support, amplitude, moments, cancellation, and NS-critical scaling.
criteria.Generative_Yield: Full credit requires a concrete next theorem move: formalize a stated Euclidean projection lemma, formalize a named thin-source counterexample, or rerank to a cheaper exact discriminator.
criteria.Q_Scalar_Connection: Full credit requires a non-circular connection to P(E) in the exhaust-efficiency scalar.
criteria.Claim_Discipline: Reject overclaims, metric-kernel substitution, generic dimensional-reduction rhetoric, and hidden Calderon residuals.
